evidence.text: I’ve never had a fried chicken steak pho and what a surprise! Broth was really tasty, noodle was good and on a separate plate the breaded fried chicken steak was a delight! We went on a weekday almost closing time so it wasn’t as busy. I’m …
Beef pho with beef balls. And Vietnamese coffee.

I recently heard of this restaurant from a friend who said they have fresh noodle so as a Vietnamese foodie I have to check them out. Love it! Southern style pho! My go to is this beef pho with beef balls. And a Vietnamese coffee. Nothing …
The "meat" was basically just fat and inedible. They did include a piece of normal flank steak though. Also weird white substance. Flavors were fine, but worse pho I've had in the city

evidence.text: Pho bánh mì spring roll advertisement

I had a great experience with the Vietnamese food here. The spring rolls were freshly made and incredibly tasty, and the pho was absolutely delicious. The broth was rich and full of flavor, making each bite really satisfying. There are also plenty of options on the menu, so there’s something for everyone to enjoy.
Generous portions.
